frame: local equirectangular (east = +x, south = +z, metres), WGS84; accurate to <1 m within the 4 km core and a few m at 10 km
toWorld: x = (lon - lon0) * kx ; z = (lat0 - lat) * ky ; y = metres above sea level (NAVD88, USGS 3DEP)
toLonLat: lon = lon0 + x / kx ; lat = lat0 - z / ky
oldFrame: before 2026-11-22 the ground used a N-S squashed frame (USGS 4326 export of a square image: 1 world m = 1.341 real m N-S); landmarks were kept, the ground was rebuilt in this frame
groundHeight: W3D.groundAt(x,z,y) / terrainH(x,z) in world.js (core + rings); drape roads at terrainH+0.15 or so
dataSource: OSM coords converted with toWorld; USGS 3DEP DEM + USGS Imagery exported per exact lon/lat bbox for this frame
